topic_title: Reducing Risk — Licensing, Registration & Insurance Synthesis
prompt: What is the core civic responsibility underlying the privilege of possessing a Texas driver license?

options.text: Asserting right-of-way aggressively over smaller vehicles and vulnerable pedestrians
Minimizing travel times between destinations regardless of roadway traffic conditions
Yielding only when law enforcement units or commercial vehicles are directly visible
Operating with utmost respect for the physical safety and property of all road users
